text.source: Results: unofficial county returns from the Michigan Secretary of State (mvic.sos.state.mi.us), updated Nov 6, 2026 1:25 PM ET, with all 83 counties reporting. These are unofficial and counts may change until the state canvass is certified. Third-party candidates (Libertarian Lydia Christensen 1.0%, U.S. Taxpayers Tim Long 0.6%, Green Douglas Marsh 0.3%, Natural Law Walter Kristy 0.2%) and write-ins are not shown. Residents: Census Bureau July 1, 2025 county estimates (Vintage 2025).
